baseline_weaknesses: Solid flat beige-green background fill (RGB 229, 241, 226) lacked storybook environment, depth, and atmospheric warmth
Soil bed was a sharp solid brown rectangle bar (y=530..600) with no grass boundary, texture, or organic grounding
Child geometric shapes floated disconnectedly in empty space with uniform shadow blits regardless of elevation
Perimeter was completely sterile with zero botanical context or garden framing
No character companion presence to connect the Activity to Greia's canonical cast
Instant silent shape appearance on click lacked tactile growth feedback or delightful animation

ground_edge.rationale: High-craft modular grass boundary creating a clean, organic separator between sky/hills and the garden soil bed.

atmosphere_sunlight.rationale: Semi-transparent diagonal light shaft adding warmth and depth to the top-right sky layer without obstructing the playfield.

ambient_clouds.rationale: Soft storybook puffy clouds floating across the upper sky.

distant_hills.rationale: Soft rolling green hills placed behind the grass boundary providing natural storybook horizon depth.

botanical_framing.rationale: Flowering bush accent anchoring the left garden corner outside the active shape placement bounds.

shape_grounding_shadow.rationale: Soft elliptical shadow grounded below placed shapes.

garden_companion.rationale: Dani is the canonical geometry/pattern companion. Positioned gently in bottom-right corner on the soil bed with contact shadow. Reacts with happy_hop and happy face upon shape creation, returns to gentle idle_bounce when waiting.

child_geometric_shapes.rationale: The child-created shapes (circles, rounded squares, 5-point regular polygons) are core educational geometry content and remain clean Pygame geometry with subtle shine highlights and growth pop animation.

canonical_character_decision.rationale: Dani represents geometry, construction, and shape recognition in Greia's canonical cast. Dani acts as an encouraging, non-intrusive garden companion observing child creations from the bottom-right corner.
canonical_character_decision.behavior: Idle state: neutral with subtle idle_bounce. On shape placement: momentary happy state with happy_hop for 0.85s. Motion-disabled mode: clean static neutral presentation.
canonical_character_decision.metadata_implication: Manifest lead/supporting character metadata remains UNNECESSARY at this stage. Direct semantic character instantiation via SceneActorDefinition in Activity code is clean, decoupled, and completely expressive.

runtime_architecture.fail_soft_resilience: Optional scenery nodes (e.g. bush.flowering.01) gracefully skip on corruption without failing gameplay

library_gap_analysis.details: The generic authoring library Pack A + canonical cast v0.1 fully provided all needed garden environment, atmospheric, framing, grounding, and character companion assets without requiring an ad-hoc Batch B expansion.
